scenarios.title: At a restaurant
scenarios.context: Polite requests to a restaurant server. 请 softens a request; 请问 introduces a question.

sentences.pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒ yì bēi shuǐ.
sentences.translation: Please give me a glass of water.
I would like to drink tea.
Excuse me, how much is it?

scenarios.title: Business icebreakers
scenarios.context: A courteous first meeting. 您 is a respectful form of you. These are language examples, not universal business etiquette rules.

sentences.pinyin: Nín hǎo, hěn gāoxìng rènshi nín.
sentences.translation: Hello, it is a pleasure to meet you.
May I ask how I should address you?
tokens: address someone by name or title
